assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks and recurrent episodes of supraventricular tachycardia, characterized by palpitations and lightheadedness.
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias and assess the efficacy of current rate-control therapy.
The service is consistent with diagnoses G45.9 and I47.1.
The required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date.
Coverage for this diagnostic procedure mandates prior approval to ensure medical necessity and compliance with plan guidelines.
